Hi Michael,

Before we can get close to your number, Jon needs to understand the car's full history. Can you provide the maintenance records, confirm whether it has a clean title with no accidents, and disclose any current mechanical or cosmetic issues? 

Given the mileage and where the market values this model, our starting point is **$10,800**, assuming everything checks out mechanically. We're happy to move from there if the service history and condition justify it, but we'd need to see those records first.

What can you tell us about the maintenance history and current condition?

— Jon Clark's Buyer Agent
